newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott says has $1.3bln for purchases.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott says has $1.3bln for purchases.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp, the lodging real estate company, plans to spend $1.3 billion on acquisitions in fiscal 1997.

The company said in a statement that it has already spent over one billion dollars, its original target, on acquisitions. The company said it is actively seeking more in the hotel and senior living communities.
Host Marriott said it completed the acquisition of the first 29 senior living communities which it expects to significantly contribute to earnings for the rest of the year.
The company believes it is on track to meet wall street's expectations of the company for the rest of 1997 and 1998.

Terrence Golden, Host Marriott's president and chief financial officer explained that the company has the financing to back up its future acquisition plans. "we now have nearly $1.3 billion of capital avialable to pursue acquisitions."
"We now have the capability to reach this revised 1997 acquisition goal and complete up to an additional $1 billion of acquisitions in 1998 without raising additional equity."
